answer: Treat trust like a harbor that charges a toll to dock: each agent must post bonded collateral and build countersigned reputation over time before it can transact at scale. A sybil swarm can spin up a thousand identities, but each one is an isolated island holding no stake and no history, so it earns nothing. Misbehavior is recorded in sable, indelible ledger entries, making forged mass identities costly and worthless rather than free.
